env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./app
stdout '^add:isoiwrap-isoi$'
stdout '^remove:drop:isoiwrap-isoiremove:drop:isiwrap-isi$'
stdout '^deep:isiisoi$'
logos test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestExternalAdd '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestExternalDeep '

# SPEC: a comptime call inside an expansion whose type arguments are
# concrete after substitution MUST expand into the same copy, at any
# depth and across package boundaries.

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedcopy

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

type Item struct {
	ID      int64   `col:"id"`
	Name    string  `col:"name"`
	Note    string? `col:"note"`
	Version int64   `col:"version"`
}

type Other struct {
	ID      int64  `col:"id"`
	Name    string `col:"name"`
	Version int64  `col:"version"`
}

func KindOf[F any]() (string, bool) {
	const switch F {
	case int64:
		return "i", true
	case string:
		return "s", true
	case string?:
		return "o", true
	}
	return "", false
}

func Wrap[E any](v *E) string {
	const if !comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[E]() {
		kind, ok := KindOf[f.Type]()
		if !ok {
			panic("lib: unsupported field " + f.Name)
		}
		out += kind
	}
	run := func() string {
		return Apply[E](v)
	}
	return out + run()
}

func Apply[E any](v *E) string {
	const if !comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[E]() {
		kind, ok := KindOf[f.Type]()
		if !ok {
			panic("lib: unsupported field " + f.Name)
		}
		out += kind
	}
	return "wrap-" + out
}

func Add[E any](v *E) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		return "add:" + Wrap[E](v)
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	return ""
}

func Drop[E any](v *E) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		return "drop:" + Wrap[E](v)
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	return ""
}

func Remove[E any](v *E) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		return "remove:" + Drop[E](v)
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	return ""
}

func DeepLeaf[E any](v *E) string {
	const if !comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	out := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[E]() {
		kind, ok := KindOf[f.Type]()
		if !ok {
			panic("lib: unsupported field " + f.Name)
		}
		out += kind
	}
	return out
}

func DeepMid[E any](v *E) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		return DeepLeaf[E](v)
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	return ""
}

func DeepTop[E any](v *E) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		return "deep:" + DeepMid[E](v)
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	return ""
}

func DeepOther[E any](v *E) string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[E]() {
		return DeepMid[E](v)
	} else {
		comptime.Error("lib: need struct")
	}
	return ""
}

-- w/lib/control.lgo --
package lib

var shapeItem = Item{}
var shapeOther = Other{}

func ControlAdd() string {
	return Add(&shapeItem)
}

func ControlRemove() string {
	s := Remove(&shapeItem)
	return s + Remove(&shapeOther)
}

func ControlDeep() string {
	return DeepTop(&shapeOther) + DeepOther(&shapeItem)
}

-- w/lib/extern_test.lgo --
package lib_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/nestedcopy/lib"
)

type engineItem struct {
	ID      int64  `col:"id"`
	Name    string `col:"name"`
	Version int64  `col:"version"`
}

func TestExternalAdd(t *testing.T) {
	got := lib.Add(&engineItem{})
	if want := "add:isiwrap-isi"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("Add = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

func TestExternalDeep(t *testing.T) {
	got := lib.DeepTop(&engineItem{})
	if want := "deep:isi"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("DeepTop = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

-- w/app/app.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/nestedcopy/lib"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(lib.ControlAdd())
	fmt.Println(lib.ControlRemove())
	fmt.Println(lib.ControlDeep())
}
